recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key studio photograph of a figure in a crawling pose, characterized by a high-contrast checkered pattern projected across the body, set against a deep black background with minimalist, geometric headline typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Checkered light pattern conforming to the three-dimensional curves of the subject
Extreme contrast between deep shadows and bright white highlights
Ultra-thin geometric display type balanced against a centered, bold secondary title
Subject positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame to allow for top-heavy typography
coreInvariants: Geometric sans-serif letterforms with consistent stroke weight

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is crouched in the lower half of the frame, spanning the width of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright checkered highlights on the subject's back and legs.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large thin typography at the top, moves down to the red accent text, and follows the curve of the subject's back from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black background occupying approximately 60% of the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with zero saturation in the primary elements, punctuated by a single high-saturation red element.

letterConstructionRules: Open counters and simplified geometric shapes (e.g., 'B' and 'R' with gaps)
Secondary text uses heavy, blocky, rounded-corner letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'R' are constructed from disconnected diagonal and vertical lines
The 'S' is a continuous, fluid geometric curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast (Hairline vs. Ultra-Bold) and color contrast (White vs. Red).

preserve: Hairline stroke weight of the top text
Red accent color for the smaller text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s/80s aesthetic and circular counters.
Similar rounded blocky feel for the secondary red text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a person in a crawling pose on a dark floor against a black background. Project a high-contrast black and white checkerboard pattern onto the subject so the squares distort over their muscles and form. Use low-key lighting to keep the background pitch black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered, hairline-thin geometric sans-serif title at the top in white. Below it, add a much smaller, bold, rounded-block subtitle in vibrant red.

verificationChecks: Is the checkerboard pattern clearly following the contours of the body?
Is the background pure black without visible details?
Is the top text extremely thin and geometric?
Is the red text centered and bold?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (Red could be Neon Green or Pink)
Stroke weight of the primary title
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Times New Roman

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the checkerboard pattern doesn't look like a flat texture but a projection.
Check that the hairline text is legible against the black background.
Verify the red color is punchy and saturated.
Confirm the composition feels 'top-heavy' with the text placement.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key photography + projected geometric patterns + extreme weight-contrast typography.
